GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 015 (22 Jul 46) LS
(SCAPIN-1076)
APO 500
22 July 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Criminal Jurisdiction over United Nations Nationals.
1. Reference: CLO No. 2725 (PK), 5 June 1946, subject: “Report on all Pending Criminal Proceedings in which Nationals of the United Nations are Defendants,” and inclosures therin.
2. Disposition of reported cases is directed as follows:
a. In cases where an appeal has been filed or pending as of 19 Feb 1946, the complete recoads thereof, with translations, will be forwarded to the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers for review.
b. Cases where the defendants have been deported will be considered closed.
c. All other cases will be transferred on demand to the jurisdiction of the military occupation courts.
3. No action taken herein shall be construed as confirmation of the Imperial Japnese Government’s allegation of nationality.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
